summary.name: Teambition
summary.one_liner: Teambition is an Alibaba-owned (DingTalk-integrated) team collaboration tool for managing projects and tasks visually, with schedules, files, and discussions.
use_cases: track demands from request to launch
organize team tasks, schedules and files
connect frontend and backend development workflows
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Teambition as an enterprise team collaboration tool for visual management of projects and tasks, aimed at product, R&D, design, marketing, operations, sales and HR teams. It lists tasks, schedules, files and discussions as core areas, per the directory listing. It states deep integration with DingTalk to reduce data silos. It describes industry scenarios including manufacturing project control, tech demand-to-release workflows, and new retail e-commerce and event management. The page also mentions a customer success team, local service network and standardized delivery process, but gives no specific feature details beyond these.
notable: Deep integration with DingTalk (Alibaba's workplace app)
Visual project and task management for cross-functional teams
Industry-specific scenarios for manufacturing, tech, new retail
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform availability beyond the website is not stated on the page
